svg.text: Assumption-based personas derived from StaffSync’s requirements and features; no user interviews are recorded in the project.
Keep accurate people records and run attendance and leave for the whole company
What do they need to DO?
Add people with roles and reporting lines
See company attendance and every leave request
Employees asking whether their leave was approved
Managers asking who is in today
Requests for attendance figures at month end
What do they THINK and FEEL?
Records split across spreadsheets, email and
No single list of pending leave
One place for people, attendance and leave
Control over who can see and change what
“I spend hours putting attendance together at month end.”
“I can’t tell which requests are still waiting.”
Decide my team’s leave quickly and know who is working today.
What do they need to DO?
Review and decide team leave requests
See team attendance at a glance
Team members asking about their requests
Clashes when two people are off together
What do they THINK and FEEL?
Requests arrive by email and chat and get
No quick view of today’s attendance
A queue of pending team requests
“I found a leave request in my inbox a week late.”
“I don’t know who is in until I walk round.”
Keeps personal notes of who is off
Passes HR notices on by hand
Record my attendance and apply for leave easily, and know the outcome.
What do they need to DO?
Apply for leave and follow its status
Nothing back after asking for leave
Different answers from HR and the manager
What do they THINK and FEEL?
No confirmation that a request was received
No record of why leave was refused
A notification when a decision is made
“I don’t know if my manager has even seen my request.”
“I only heard about the training after it was full.”
Keeps own record of days off
Quotes are illustrative statements written to express each persona’s needs. They are not recorded interviews.
